discard.title: Delete this report?
discard.body: What you wrote and any photos, videos or voice notes will be removed from this phone. This cannot be undone.

pinSheet.title: Enter your PIN
pinSheet.body: Your reports are waiting to send. Enter your 6-digit PIN to send them.
pinSheet.label: PIN
pinSheet.wrong: That PIN is not right. Try again.

o01.title: Choose your language
o01.hint: You can change it later in Settings.

o02.title: What this app keeps
o02.line1: We do not ask your name.
o02.line2: We remove the location from your photos.
o02.line3: You can withdraw a report before review starts.
o02.line4: If someone may be in danger, call 112. This app does not send help.

o03.title: Who are you?
o03.observerHint: Sign in with the code and PIN from your card
o03.citizenHint: No account. You get a receipt code.
o03.checkStatus: Check a report with a receipt code

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.codeHint: It is on your card. Example: OBS-7K2P
signIn.pinHint: 6 numbers. The first time, use the PIN on your card.
signIn.offline: You need network to sign in. Move to a place with network, then try again.
signIn.codeFormat: Observer codes look like OBS-7K2P. Check your card.
signIn.wrong: The code or PIN is not right. Check your card and try again.
signIn.triesLeft: {count, plural, one {# try left before a short wait.} other {# tries left before a short wait.}}
signIn.revoked: This code no longer works. Ask your coordinator for a new one.
signIn.forgot: Forgot your PIN? Your coordinator can give you a new code.

setPin.title: Choose your own PIN
setPin.body: Pick 6 numbers you will remember. Do not use your birthday or 123456. Do not share it.
setPin.tooSimple: That PIN is too easy to guess. Try different numbers.
setPin.mismatch: The two PINs are not the same. Type them again.
setPin.sameAsCard: Choose a PIN that is different from the one on your card.
setPin.done: Your PIN is saved. Use it next time you sign in.

revoked.title: This observer code no longer works
revoked.body: Your coordinator has stopped this code. You have been signed out on every phone.
revoked.unsent: {count, plural, one {# report on this phone was not sent.} other {# reports on this phone were not sent.}}
revoked.unsentHint: Get a new code from your coordinator. After you sign in with it, you can send or delete them.
revoked.signInNew: Sign in with a new code
revoked.clearTitle: Delete these reports from this phone?
revoked.clearBody: They were never sent. If you delete them, they are gone for good. This cannot be undone.

o04.title: Home
o04.myReportsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No reports yet} one {# report} other {# reports}}
o04.messagesCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing new} one {# report needs you} other {# reports need you}}
o04.askHint: Help and rules from approved guides
o04.unsent: {count, plural, one {# report is on this phone and not sent yet.} other {# reports are on this phone and not sent yet.}}

o04.intakePaused: Your organisation has paused new reports. You can still write reports. They will wait on this phone.

install.title: Add ElectraGuard to your home screen

incident.draftKept: Your report is saved on this phone.

o05.title: What happened?
o05.hint: Choose the closest one. Not sure is fine.

access.title: What kind of barrier?
access.noAssistance: No help for people who need it

o06.title: Is anyone in danger right now?
o06.hint: Danger means someone could be hurt now.

emergency.title: Get safe first
emergency.step1: Move away from the danger to a safe place.
emergency.step2: Call 112 for police, fire or ambulance.
emergency.step3: Tell your coordinator if you can.
emergency.noDispatch: This app does not send help. Your report goes to reviewers, not to the police.
emergency.continue: I am safe. Continue my report

o07.title: Where did it happen?
o07.unknownUnit: I don't know the polling unit
o07.unknownUnitNote: We will use the ward only.
o07.noResults: No polling unit matches "{query}". Check the code, or choose step by step.
o07.listMissing: The polling-unit list is not on this phone yet. Connect to network once to download it.
o07.error: Choose a polling unit, or choose a ward and tap "I don't know the polling unit".
o07.noGps: We never use your phone's location.

o08.title: When did it happen?
o08.watNote: All times are West Africa Time.
o08.future: That time has not happened yet. Choose an earlier time.

old.title: This was more than 7 days ago
old.body: Is the date right? Older events are still useful, but reviewers need to know.

o09.title: Tell us what happened
o09.label: What happened
o09.hint2: Who was affected? Use roles, not names.
o09.speakUnavailable: Speaking is not available on this phone. Tap the microphone on your keyboard to talk instead.
o09.micDenied: The app cannot use the microphone. You can type, or allow the microphone in your phone settings.
o09.nameWarning: This may name a person. Please describe roles, not names. For example: "a party agent", "a presiding officer".
o09.nameKeep: It is not a name, keep it
o09.tooShort: Write a little more so a reviewer can understand. At least {min} letters.
o09.tooLong: That is too long. Keep it under {max} letters.

o10.title: Add photos, video or voice?
o10.hint: This is optional. You can send without it.
o10.blurHint: Hides faces before it leaves this phone.
o10.sizeOffline: {size} · will send when you have network
o10.count: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing added} one {# item added} other {# items added}}
o10.limitItems: You can add up to {max} items.
o10.tooBig: This file is too big. Choose one under {max}.
o10.wrongType: This kind of file cannot be added. Choose a photo, video or voice recording.
o10.cameraDenied: The app cannot use the camera. You can choose a file instead, or allow the camera in your phone settings.
o10.micDenied: The app cannot use the microphone. You can choose a file instead, or allow the microphone in your phone settings.
o10.spaceLow: This phone is almost full. Large videos may not fit.

o11.title: Check and send
o11.hint: Check each part. Tap Change to fix it.
o11.savedOffline: Saved on this phone. It will send when you have network.
o11.queueFull: There are already {max} reports waiting on this phone. Send them first, or delete one.
o11.intakePaused: Your organisation has paused new reports. Your report is saved on this phone and will send when they start again.
o11.notConfirmed: We sent your report but have not heard back. We are checking. It will not be sent twice.

o12.title: Report received

next.title: What happens next
next.line1: A reviewer will read your report.
next.line2: If they have a question, you will see it in Messages.
next.line3: You can withdraw it until review starts.

upload.missing: This file is no longer on the phone. Choose the file again.

o12.keepOpen: Keep the app open until all items say Saved.

o13.empty: No reports yet. When you send a report, it will show here.
o13.offlineList: Offline. Showing what this phone knows. Status may be older.
o13.loadError: We could not get your reports. Try again.

o14.title: Report {ref}

question.title: Question for you
question.queued: Your answer is saved on this phone. It will send when you have network.
question.sent: Answer sent. The reviewer can see it.

conversation.title: Messages with your reviewer
conversation.label: Write a message
conversation.notAssigned: A reviewer has not been assigned yet. You can still write; they will see it.

o14.contentNotKept: To keep this phone safe, the full text is not kept here. It is with the reviewers.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this report?
withdraw.body: Your text, photos, videos and voice notes will be deleted. Reviewers will only see that a report was withdrawn. This cannot be undone.
withdraw.tooLate: Review has started, so this report can no longer be withdrawn. You can send a message to the reviewer instead.
withdraw.offline: You need network to withdraw a report.

deleteLocal.note: This report was never sent. Deleting it removes it for good.

o14.closedNote: This report is closed. Thank you for reporting.
o14.loadError: We could not open this report. Try again.

o15.title: Polling-day checklist
o15.hint: Fill each stage when it happens. Each stage sends on its own.

q.arrivalUnit: Which polling unit are you at?
q.priority: Did older people, disabled people and pregnant women go first?
q.assistance: Was help available for voters who needed it?
q.inducementSeen: Did you see anyone offer money or gifts for votes?
q.countPublic: Was the counting done where people could see?
q.agentsSigned: Did the party agents sign the result sheet?
q.sheetPosted: Was the result sheet posted for the public?

o15.reportThisHint: We fill in what, where and when for you.
o15.savedOffline: Saved on this phone. It will send when you have network.
o15.needUnit: Fill in Arrival first so we know your polling unit.
o15.unanswered: {count, plural, one {# question has no answer. Send anyway?} other {# questions have no answer. Send anyway?}}
o15.draftExists: You have a report you did not finish. We opened it. Finish or delete it first, then report this.

o16.title: Check the result sheet
o16.notResult: Consistency check for review. This is not a result.
o16.rules: Only use the sheet posted for the public. We never add up votes or show a winner.

photo.title: Take a photo of the posted sheet
photo.tip: Hold the phone straight. Make sure all numbers are sharp and in the light.
photo.reading: Reading the numbers from the photo
photo.readFailed: We could not read the numbers. Please type them from the sheet.
photo.offline: No network, so we cannot read the photo now. Please type the numbers from the sheet.

numbers.title: Type exactly what the sheet shows
numbers.hint: Even if a number looks wrong, type what is written. Reviewers check it.
numbers.suggested: Suggested from the photo. Check it against the sheet.
numbers.blank: Leave empty if the sheet does not show it
numbers.tooBig: That number is too big for one polling unit. Check it again.

o16.confirm: I checked every number against the posted sheet
o16.confirmError: Tick the box after you check every number.

o17.title: Messages
o17.hint: Reports where a reviewer has written to you.
o17.newMessage: {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}
o17.empty: No messages. When a reviewer writes to you, it will show here.
o17.loadError: We could not get your messages. Try again.
o17.offline: Offline. New messages will show when you have network.

o18.title: Discussions
o18.hint: Talk with other observers in your area about a shared problem. Only your observer code is shown.

invite.rules: If you join, others in this discussion see your observer code and what you write. They never see your reports.

o18.empty: No discussions. A moderator may invite you if there is a shared problem in your area.
o18.loadError: We could not get discussions. Try again.

thread.postHint: Text only. No names, phone numbers or exact places. Ward is the smallest place to mention.
thread.shareNote: To use something from here in your own report, write it in your report yourself.
thread.leaveBody: You will stop seeing new posts. Your posts stay unless a moderator removes them.
thread.removed: You are no longer in this discussion.

o19.title: What do you want to know?
o19.label: Your question
o19.hint: Example: What should I do if the polling unit opens late?
o19.noAnswer: I don't have an approved answer to that. Contact your coordinator.
o19.offline: You need network to ask a question. Saved guides are below.
o19.note: Answers only come from approved guides. They are not legal advice.
o19.error: We could not get an answer. Try again.
o19.otherLanguage: This guide is only approved in {language}.
